# Screening Review Guidance

## Wrong-field and entity-type review

Reviewers should compare the semantic role of the payment field with the watchlist entity type. A vessel name retrieved from a party-name field is not automatically a true match; the analyst should verify whether the field permits vessel candidates and document the conflict.

## Denial language

Narrative text stating no business relationship or another explicit denial may support false-positive clearance only when the phrase window and transaction context demonstrate that the listed party is being disclaimed rather than paid or controlled.

## Legal-control context

Trustee, receiver, liquidator, and bankruptcy-control language requires legal-control documentation and manual review. The named party may be referenced because assets are under independent legal administration.
